summary: Workers AI includes 10,000 Neurons per day on Free and Paid Workers plans, resetting at 00:00 UTC. Model-dependent neuron costs mean this is not a fixed number of generations or tokens. On Workers Free, operations fail after exceeding the allowance; Workers Paid bills above it at the published rate. Some models require a paid billing method (Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits), including Kimi K2.6/K2.7 Code, GLM-5.2/5.3/5.3-Flash and the listed DeepSeek V4 variants.
claim_steps: Create a Cloudflare account and open Workers AI.
Create an API token or add an AI binding to a Worker.
Choose a model available to your billing tier and stay within the 10,000-Neuron daily allocation. Some listed frontier models require Workers Paid or prepaid AI Gateway credits.
Monitor usage; model-dependent neuron costs determine how much the allocation can generate.
